taiwan_insert.title: 喜達隆注射劑（西華美達諾）〝信東〞 CETAZONE INJECTION (CEFMETAZOLE) "S.T.", 衛署藥製字第035182號 (信東生技)
taiwan_insert.version: Online structured insert (no revision date shown); history insert PDF 印刷版次3 dated 104-10-23 (2015-10-23); carton labels 106-10-27 / 110-03-18
taiwan_insert.note: License derived from NHI code AC35182277 on hospital page. Insert has NO renal dose table, no contraindication/pregnancy/lactation sections (目前尚無資訊). Dose: adult 1-2 g/day in 2 divided doses IV/IV infusion; severe up to 4 g/day; children 25-100 mg/kg/day in 2-4 doses, up to 150 mg/kg/day.

absence_notes.dailymed: No SPL in DailyMed (spls.json?drug_name=cefmetazole total 0). Only US product Zefazone (Pharmacia & Upjohn, NDA050637 approved 1989-12-11; NDA050683) is Discontinued per Drugs@FDA (api.fda.gov drugsfda). No current FDA label.
absence_notes.smpc: Not marketed in UK; eMC search "cefmetazole" returns no results.
absence_notes.lactmed: No LactMed record (esearch cefmetazole[title] AND lactmed[book] count 0; not in local archive).
